in_sanskrit.name: Hasibul
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Blessing, gift, treasure
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Hasibul एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Hasibul is derived from the Arabic language and translates to 'giver of gifts' or 'treasurer'. In Hindu mythology, it is also associated with the deity Vishnu, symbolizing the bestower of blessings and prosperity.
